info.name: Managed Database for PostgreSQL and MySQL Access Control List Statistics API

params.name: region
params.description: The region you want to target

params.name: project_id
params.description: (Optional) Number of emails for this Project. (UUID format)

params.name: domain_id
params.description: (Optional) Number of emails sent from this domain (must be coherent with the `project_id` and the `organization_id`). (UUID format)

params.name: since
params.description: (Optional) Number of emails created after this date. (RFC 3339 format)

params.name: until
params.description: (Optional) Number of emails created before this date. (RFC 3339 format)

params.name: mail_from
params.description: (Optional) Number of emails sent with this sender's email address.

items.docs: Get information on your emails' statuses.
